entities.name: the 汴河 from u 21850 to 23300
entities.what: The river between the north bank (the trackers' bank, the houses and the terrace on stilts) and the south bank's east end: plain silk with long ripple lines and small eddy swirls. 豪华客船 lies along the north shore, the boat with six men at its great stern sweep is in midstream, and two boats and a small boat's bow lie along the south bank's spits at the bottom. No strong current lines here (汴水悍激 is further east).
entities.vis: part: 豪华客船 and its cargo hide the north shore at u 22400-23300; boats hide the south shore at u 21965-22240 and 22290-22680
entities.note: No shoreline is inked. shore_n: where the north bank's dark wash and weed strokes stop and the ripples begin: v 455-520 at u 21950-22150 (a row of small shore ticks at u 22020-22200, v 495-520), bulging south to about v 560-590 at u 22250-22400 (the restyle's grassy bank there agrees), then hidden behind 豪华客船's bow post and cargo; at u 22955 the landing steps (S2.str.landing_steps_22950) reach the water at v ~488, and the terrace's stilts (structures_w) stand in the water to v ~485-500. shore_s: the south bank's mound meets the water at (21980, 1548) where the open boat is tied; south of that boat ripples run down to the flat bank's edge (21890,1673)->(22127,1733); east of the small boat's bow a low spit's upper edge runs (22150,1692) to (22300,1662) and down to the silk's bottom edge at (22680, 1790); east of 22680 the silk's edge cuts the water (nothing south of it is painted). SEAM POINTS: u 21850 shore_n (21850, 425, est), shore_s (21850, 1418, est: behind the mound's crest); u 23300 shore_n (23300, 500, est); shore_s ends at the silk's edge (22680, 1790). Water: open silk with ripples at u 22300-23450, v 920-1480 (nothing floats there). Merge: seam points set so the reaches join: west (21850, 345) est and (21850, 1432) est (river_w's; this unit had 425 and 1418); east (23300, 496) est, the mean of this unit's 500 and river_m's 492 (hidden under the terrace).

entities.name: north bank from the trackers to the terrace
entities.what: The north bank's slope down to the water below the trackers' path and in front of the houses: dark ink wash with low weed and grass strokes, a band of reeds or weeds at v 380-440 in front of the houses (u 22550-22900), rough landing steps at the terrace's west end, and the terrace's stilts in the water further east.
entities.vis: part: 豪华客船's bow post, roof and cargo hide the foot of the bank at u 22400-23300; the terrace on stilts stands over it at u 22950-23500
entities.note: bank_top = where the walkable ground stops and the washed slope begins: just south of the trackers' feet (t2's tracker feet v 235-386 at u 21867-22172), the foot of the weed band in front of the houses, the top tread of the landing steps (22918, 405) at the terrace's west wall foot, and the terrace's floor sill line (v 438-456, t4) where the bank runs under the hall. No vertical bank face is painted anywhere in the range. The restyle's six walkers and broad stone stair on this strip (u 22290-22950) are not painted (t3's check). Merge: seam points set: west bank_top (21850, 274) est and shore (21850, 345) est (this unit had 300 and 425); east bank_top (23300, 452) est and shore (23300, 496) est, the means with river_m's 470 and 492 (hidden under the terrace). FRAME: its shore line stands on the support `water` (support_by), like the river's shores; its bank_top on the ground.

entities.name: south bank's flat edge by the open boat
entities.what: The flat, light top of the south bank between the thatched roof and the water, ending in a straight low edge where the big man in the broad hat sits (t2's), with the water in front of it south of the open boat.
entities.vis: part: t2's big seated man and timber frame stand on it; the small boat's bow cuts its east end
entities.note: Edge points (21550,1637), (21890,1673), (22127,1733) as t2 read them, checked here; ripples run down to the edge at u 22050-22130 (south of the open boat), so the edge is the shore there. West of u ~21990 the flat lies behind the mound and the timber frame and does not touch the water. FRAME: its shore line stands on the support `water` (support_by), like the river's shores; its bank_top on the ground.

entities.name: low spit at the bottom edge
entities.what: A low spit of dark-washed ground with clumps of low growth at the bottom of the silk, under the mat-roofed boat moored along it; it runs off the silk's bottom edge at u ~22680.
entities.vis: part: the mat-roofed boat's hull and its bucket man's pour overlap its top edge
entities.note: The setup's first look put nothing south of the water east of u 22300; the scan shows this spit's wash to u 22680 (dark clumps at u 22400-22500, v 1740-1770). bank_top = shore: the spit is drawn as a low tongue with no face. Nobody stands on it. The mat-roofed boat's mooring rope reaches its top at about (22490, 1672). FRAME: its shore line stands on the support `water` (support_by), like the river's shores; its bank_top on the ground.

entities.name: rough landing steps at the terrace's west end
entities.what: Five or six rough stone (or log) steps going down from the bank at the foot of the terrace's west wall to the water, drawn as irregular slabs with dark weeds or stones beside them on the east.
entities.vis: part: the tow rope (river_m's) crosses its foot at v ~485-495
entities.note: Treads at about v 410, 425, 437, 449, 458, 470 (u 22920-22975); 40-45 px wide along u. t3 and t4 left it to structures_w (stair) or river_w2 (bank): recorded here as a landing stair (river role); drop one at the merge if structures_w also records it. The restyle draws a broad cut-stone stair and a man at its foot: the scan has rough slabs and nobody. WATER-LEVEL CHECK: see the report (top tread v 410 over the waterline v ~486). Merge: structures_w recorded the same steps as S2.str.stone_steps_22950 (conf low; retired as a duplicate): rounded stone marks stepping down to the right at u 22910-22995, v 407-475, top (22950, 410), foot (22955, 478, est), from the long house's east doors and the terrace's west end to the water's edge; its other reading is a rubble revetment under the terrace's west end.

entities.name: mooring post with 豪华客船's rope
entities.what: A thin post standing in the water off the terrace, with a rope knotted round its top in loops; the rope swings down in a long curve to 豪华客船's roof rail, and a short loose tail hangs from the knot.
entities.vis: part: its foot is hidden behind 豪华客船's roof and cargo
entities.note: Post line u 23124-23126 from v ~492 to ~550 visible; the knot at u 23124-23155, v 489-515 lies just where 逆水行舟's tow rope (river_m's, v ~512) passes, so part of the knot may be the tow rope crossing. Its foot is est at the boat's far side (the shore is at v ~495 here, so it stands in the water's edge: the river agent's). The restyle draws the same pole and rope. Other reading (conf low): a terrace stilt (structures_w's) with the rope tied to it.

entities.name: 豪华客船, the long passenger boat
entities.what: A very long passenger boat moored along the north bank below the terrace, bow west: at the bow a curved post rising from the stem to a netted knob (a lantern cage or fender basket) and a beam with lashings projecting west at deck level; an open fore canopy with a dark mat roof on four posts (u 22465-22560), then a cabin with mat-curtained walls (22580-22700), a long cabin with lattice windows, panelled sills and a door (22700-23300) with a chair or bench back (u 22960-23020, v 720-770) and a table with things on it (u 23090-23140, v 730-770) seen through its openings, an open bay with two passengers (23300-23440), and an after cabin with hanging mat blinds under a dark mat roof (23440-23700) carrying on top a deck with a windlass (23360-23430) and a small arched mat shelter (23490-23640); a narrow side walkway runs outside the cabins. Cargo lies on the roof: coiled ropes, a drum, round baskets and bales, a rolled mat and a big round basket. A ladder leans from the side walkway to the roof at u 23240-23310. A mooring rope runs from S2.prop.mooring_post_23126 to its roof rail. No mast is up; no sweep or rudder shows (the stern is hidden).
entities.vis: part: its stern is hidden behind the bows of 逆水行舟's two hulls (river_m's); the far side is behind the cabins
entities.src: 名画记: 豪华客船 (pin 17); 余辉: 客船启程 (?)
entities.note: ORIENTATION: bow west (conf med): the west end has the raked stem, the curved ornamental post and the projecting beam (S3's river_w reads the same projecting beam at a bow); the east end carries the windlass on the after-cabin roof (a stern windlass hauls the rudder) and a small railed stern panel at (23690-23730, 640-700); the rudder itself is hidden. Other reading: bow east (then swap front/rear, facing 0). The setup's brief calls the windlass deck a "foredeck"; it is the after-cabin roof. 客船启程 (余辉) may be this boat: a man climbs the ladder toward the roof where the mooring rope is made fast, as if casting off; the strokes don't settle it. SCALE CUE: waterline 22545-23725 (about 1180 px); side walkway v ~840 over the waterline v ~910 at u 23200 (70 px); cabin from walkway (v 840) to eave (v ~700) about 140 px; lattice window bays 45-55 px wide; the standing boatman on the walkway is 145 px tall. WATERLINE: the hull's lowest strake: (22545, 775) at the stem, (22700, 850), (22800, 877), (22900, 893), (23000, 903), (23200, 910), (23400, 910), (23560, 900), then hidden; rear est at the stern (u ~23725, behind 逆水行舟's bows) on the level of the amidships waterline. The hull lies at a slant, its bow further north (facing about 172). 逆水行舟's tow rope (river_m's) passes over its roof cargo at v ~490-515.

entities.vis: part: the cargo hides his legs
entities.note: Lying: foot = middle of the body on the cargo top, est. Roof eave below him at v ~640-650, the waterline straight below at about v 880. About 50 px from head to hip.

entities.name: 豪华客船 and the people on it
entities.what: The long passenger boat moored at the terrace, with a passenger lying on the roof cargo, a man on the side walkway, a man climbing the ladder to the roof where the mooring rope is tied, two passengers in the open bay and a boatman at the windlass on the after-cabin roof. Perhaps 余辉's 客船启程 (a passenger boat setting off).
entities.note: The diners on the terrace above (t4's S2.grp.terrace_diners_23230) look down on it.

entities.name: boat with six men at its great stern sweep
entities.what: A boat in midstream heading west (upstream), its hull running west under the great willow's whips: a planked after deck where six men crowd along the loom of a great sweep (大橹); a stern frame of crossbeams lashed together overhangs the stern eastward to about u 22420, the loom crossing it at a pivot; the sweep's long shaft runs on east-south-east into the water and ends in a broad flat blade with an upturned tip at about u 22945. The stern's side carries a decorated oval panel with two eye-like marks.
entities.vis: part: west of u ~22050 the hull is lost under the great willow's whips (t2's S2.tree.willow_great_21345); its bow is not painted
entities.note: THE "SKIFF" IS THE SWEEP'S BLADE: the long shaft from the men's hands runs unbroken past the stern frame to (22818, 1089), where its two edges spread into a flat blade (u 22780-22945, v 1057-1112) with an upturned tip; there is no gunwale, thwart or second hull line, so it is not a separate boat (S3's river_w boat at 15595 has the same long sweep with five men and a blade in the water). ORIENTATION: stern east (the sweep is worked over it, the lead's rule), bow west (hidden); conf med. Other reading: the eye-marked oval panel could be a bow decoration (then the boat heads east and the sweep is a bow sweep); not taken. The men lean on the loom at about knee height (a bound loom shows at u 22250-22330, v 940-965) where it runs east to the pivot on the stern frame. SCALE CUE: deck edge v ~975-1000; the hull's side drops to the waterline est v ~1080-1115 at u 22100-22200 (the stern rises); the men are 140-157 px tall; sweep about 700 px from the men's hands to the tip. front est at the last hull planks before the whips (u ~22030-22050) less a little; its true bow is unknown (builder choice).

entities.vis: part: the crowd and the loom hide the feet
entities.note: Deck edge v ~975-995 under him; the waterline straight below est v ~1080-1110. Feet est at the leg strokes' ends (v 965-975).

entities.name: six men working the great sweep
entities.what: Six boatmen crowd along the loom of a great stern sweep (大橹), heaving it together to drive their boat west (upstream) past 豪华客船; the sweep's blade trails far behind in the water.
entities.note: Counted head by head at zoom 3.6: six (the restyle paints seven). 张安治's and Hansen's "trackers" are t2's five men on the north bank, not this crew.

entities.name: open boat tied to the south bank's mound
entities.what: A small open boat with thwarts and floor boards, no cabin, lying at the foot of the south bank's mound; its squared west end is tied by a twisted rope to the mound's face, and small knobs or bollards stand on its far gunwale. A man sits in it, and a second shape crouches at its east end.
entities.vis: part: its east end touches the mat-roofed boat's west end
entities.note: ORIENTATION not painted (conf low): front put at the tied west end; no rudder, sweep or oar shows (the bar under the west end is the hull's near side in perspective). The rope's far end is on the mound's east face (S2.grd.mound_south_bank_21420) at about (21905, 1490); no stake shows. The raked pole with a hanging cloth that rises behind its east end is the mat-roofed boat's (S2.veh.boat_mat_roof_22290). SCALE CUE: about 270 px long; near gunwale v ~1536 over the waterline v ~1559 at u 22100 (a low open boat, about 23 px).

entities.name: man seated in the open boat
entities.what: A man in a dark coat seen from behind, sitting on a thwart in the middle of the open boat with a small dark cap, facing north across the river.
entities.vis: part: seen from behind; the far gunwale crosses his head
entities.note: Read from a dark hatched mass (u 22040-22085, v 1453-1497) under a round dark knob (22039-22053, 1430-1439) with a thwart across; the other knobs on the far gunwale at u ~22010 and 22092 are bollards (the restyle makes them two more people). Gunwale v ~1536, waterline v ~1559 below him.

entities.name: crouching figure at the open boat's east end

entities.vis: faded
entities.note: BOTH READINGS: a light rounded shape (u 22147-22193, v 1513-1543) over a dark hatched mass (22149-22201, 1541-1567): a crouching boatman with a hat (the restyle's reading: a man in blue with a basket) or a basket with a cloth. Recorded as a figure, conf low. The brief's "about 5 people" here are the restyle's; the scan has these two at most.

entities.name: the open boat and the two in it
entities.what: The small open boat tied to the south bank's mound, with a man seated in it and a crouching figure at its east end.

entities.name: mat-roofed boat moored along the south spit
entities.what: A long boat moored along the low south spit, bow west: a long arched mat roof on posts over its west two thirds (u 22290-22780), with cloths or curtains hanging under its west end; a raked pole (a lowered mast or a stowed quant) leans west from the roof's west post with a cloth (a furled sail?) hanging from it; an open after deck and, at the east end, an overhanging stern frame of lashed beams with a rudder whose stock stands at u ~22885 and whose blade lies along the waterline to u ~23050. A rope runs from its side down to the spit. On the deck under the roof's middle lie a flat woven object (a straw sandal, a folded mat or a basket lid; u 22440-22495, v 1592-1615) and a small staved tub (u 22505-22535, v 1580-1615). A man bends over the near gunwale pouring a bucket into the river.
entities.vis: part: the open boat's east end and the hanging cloth hide its west end
entities.note: ORIENTATION: stern east (the rudder stock and blade and the overhanging stern frame), bow west under the pole; conf med. The pole: from (22190, 1332) to the roof's west post top (22278, 1505), bound at (22215, 1430), a cloth hanging from it to v ~1560; the brief's "pole or mast at ≈ 22100" for the first bottom boat is this pole. Its rope: from the near side at (22555, 1612) to the spit (S2.grd.south_bank_spit_22400) at about (22490, 1672). SCALE CUE: hull 22290-22880 at the waterline (about 590 px), the stern frame to 23062; near gunwale v ~1585 over the waterline v ~1680 at u 22700 (about 95 px); roof posts at u ~22280 and ~22735, roof top v ~1440. The setup's "two cabin boats at the bottom" are the open boat (21965-22240) and this one (22290-23060). Second pass (west): the two small things on the deck under the roof (crop c_deckobj.jpg, i_matboat.jpg; the restyle paints a straw sandal and a wooden tub) were in no entity; as the boat's gear they go in its `what` (the river rule: cargo in `what`).

entities.name: man pouring a bucket over the boat's side
entities.what: A boatman with dark hair bent over the near gunwale under the mat roof's east end, tipping a wooden bucket so its water pours in a stream down the hull into the river; his hunched back rounded to the east. Perhaps an offering poured at the boat's side (余辉's 船侧祭神).
entities.vis: part: the gunwale and the bucket hide his legs
entities.note: Head (u 22605-22625, v 1545-1570), bucket (22605-22650, 1590-1628), the stream to v ~1720; the dark hatched rounded mass at u 22640-22700, v 1540-1600 is read as his own hunched back (BOTH READINGS: his back, or a second crouching man; the restyle paints a second man on the gunwale with a basket). Gunwale v ~1595 under him, waterline v ~1690. Whether he empties slops or pours a libation (船侧祭神) is not settled by the strokes.

entities.name: the mat-roofed boat and its bucket man
entities.what: The long mat-roofed boat moored along the south spit, a man bending over its side to pour a bucket into the river.

entities.name: small boat's bow at the silk's edge
entities.what: Only the bow of a small boat shows, coming in from below the silk's bottom edge beside the south bank's flat edge: a pointed dark-hatched bow with a short post and the curve of its near gunwale; the rest of the hull runs off the silk to the south-west. Nobody is seen in it.
entities.vis: part: the silk's bottom edge cuts it below v ~1790
entities.note: Visible hull u 22020-22165, v 1720-1790; front and rear est at the silk's edge (its true length is not painted: builder choice). t2's big man in the broad hat (S2.fig.big_hat_man_south_bank_22045) sits on the bank's edge just west of the bow; read as on the bank (t2), not in this boat. If the merge puts him in the boat, he would be its crew.
